plan_review.notes: Alt A: multi-pass/reducer FSM — adopted as structural improvement (pipeline passes). Alt B: single flat table with full upfront context — rejected: wastes API calls for early-exit PRs. Alt C: named rule functions/centralised finaliser — incorporated as the terminal dispatch table. Design refined: (1) ownership cleanup (R01-R02) becomes dedicated pass, not dispatch rows; (2) Phase A expanded to include closing-issues fetch for pendingHumanApproval so R06/R07 guards are correctly gated; (3) multi-pass pipeline made explicit: preamble, ownership-cleanup, lease-ops, waiting-cleanup, human-approval, early-decisions (R03-R12 via table), expensive-facts, side-effects, terminal-dispatch; (4) terminal dispatch table covers only TERMINAL actions (admission-wait, queue, arm-auto-merge, GC skip/release, dispatch-copilot) — non-terminal effects remain in pipeline passes; (5) row ordering assertion added to dispatch-table.mjs (runtime + test); (6) every-combination claim narrowed to terminal recovery decision; (7) throws on unmapped combination for internal invariant violations only.
